asset.name: TaskGraph
asset.description: The dependency-oriented task visualization with status, ownership, expansion, selection, filters, and a list-based alternative that is fully equivalent rather than a degraded fallback.

requires.reason: Layout, pan, zoom, and the accessible summary are shared.
The list-equivalent presentation is a shared hierarchical collection.

rationale: The list alternative must be equivalent, not lesser. A graph-only task view is unusable by keyboard and assistive technology, and is also unusable by anyone on a small screen.
